posts.author: Dutchelm05
posts.content_md:
Hello great DCG minds,

Can anyone tell me if they have seen this before? 

I've been making film for many months now and never saw this before.

So here is what I was doing...

I was experimenting with AmDi concentrations.

I had a batch of emulsion in the frig (which has worked in days pass) so I heated it up and divided the stuff in three different Pyrex containers (about 100ml each)

I then added AmDi (+2 gram +4 gram and +5 grams) Normal being 100-12-3 I want to get to 100-12-5, 100-12-7 or 100-12-8.

I ran each one in a stirrer for 10 minutes each at about 55-60C.

I attempted a mold process on three plates.

When I tried to separate the mold almost all the emulsion went towards the Rain-x side

OK odd, I’m not a pro at mold so….

So I tried a veil/spin just so I can see what was going on.

I applied the emulsion as I have done dozens of times and wal-la 

This occurred in room temperature (about 62F) and after like 20-30 minutes.

It seems to be worst (much worst) with the higher concentration on AmDi

Thank you!

Oh and Happy New Year to you all....

posts.author: Dutchelm05
posts.content_md:
Wow thanks Martin and Dave.

So I guess I'm confused Dave. I was following up on one of your recommendations of increasing AmDi. 

Quote “in the old days all dcg holographers were using blue lasers so the AMdi concentration was low, around 3-5%, if you are using a green laser i would use a higher amount of AMdi (like5-7%) 

ive had very good success using mold method with a 110/14/7, with a min drying time of 24-48 hours . “

So I’ve been working with 2.6% (100-12-3)

I went to 4.4% (100-12-5) result was it did not crystallize 

Then 6.2% (100-12-7) result was it crystallized around the edges

Then 7.1% (100-12-8) result was crap-o-la

Is there something I'm missing? Should I start from scatch and try again?

At first I was resistant in increase AmDi because I was worried that the extra chemical would reduce my light to the object (like an OD filter). I remember back in my 532nm making days that the glasses we used were orange and that in absorbed all the 532nm but after seeing the spectra scan I thought to give it a try.

Thanks for you help.

Tony

posts.content_md:
> **Dutchelm05:** So I guess I'm confused Dave. I was following up on one of your recommendations of increasing AmDi.Should I start from scatch and try again?Tony

 you probably dont need to start from scratch (even tho i have a few times). conditions from your lab to mine will vary alot, air tem, humidty,water ph ,just to name a few. you need to find your limit to the ammount you can put in befor it goes to crystals. now it seems you have found amdi limit. now play with thickness and ammount of water/gelatin and see what happens..... so many variables im getting a headache thinking about them all ............
